items.title: Boeing (BA) Names Ryan L Shedd Senior Vice President And Controller
items.summary: Boeing (NYSE:BA) appoints Ryan L. Shedd as Senior Vice President and Controller, succeeding retiring executive Michael J. Cleary. The leadership change reshapes a key role within Boeing's finance organization and its oversight of financial reporting. Cleary is set to retire after a long tenure with the company, prompting the planned transition in the controller position. items.title: Boeing (BA) Engineers, Technical Workers Reject Contract Offer
